olivia: Quick sync — I sketched a PRD/launch playbook for FnCall validation and graceful degradation. Need alignment on acceptance criteria, error taxonomy, telemetry, and rollout. Can we lock scope by EOD Fri?

ajay: +1. Important to decide default mode: permissive (best-effort) vs strict (reject on schema mismatch).

mike: For model outputs we should support soft validation (warn + field coercion) and hard validation (reject). Soft mode needs confidence signals from the model.

sara: SDK note — consumers want stable, typed error codes (e.g. FNC_SCHEMA_ERR, FNC_RUNTIME_ERR, FNC_FALLBACK). Also a tiny helper that normalizes errors across SDKs.

dan: Security: mandate redaction hooks on function args before logs; and KMS-protected audit logs for Private deployments. Also list which fields are sensitive in schema metadata.

olivia: Draft acceptance checklist (high level): 1) schema validation implemented (soft + hard), 2) clear error codes + docs, 3) fallback policy (model variant / routing), 4) telemetry events for validation failures and fallbacks, 5) canary rollout plan + opt-in for Dedicated/Private. Thoughts?

ajay: Implementation notes: runtime will run two passes — schema check + optional autorepair pass. Example failure payload we return:```json
{
  "error_code": "FNC_SCHEMA_ERR",
  "message": "missing required field 'amount'",
  "suggested_fix": "provide integer amount or enable coercion"
}
```

mike: We need an eval set of ~1500 prompts that exercise nested objects, arrays, optional/nullable, type coercion, and explicit unknown-key handling. Also add a metric: % of successful binds after coercion.

sara: UX: expose a per-route config: validation_mode=[soft|strict|off], fallback_policy=[model_variant|noop|invoke-hook], telemetry_level=[minimal|detailed]. Default: soft for hosted, strict opt-in for Dedicated/Private.

dan: Also require a compliance flag for routes handling regulated data. If set, strict mode + audit-only logs for first 30 days during canary.

olivia: Rollout proposal: internal infra/devX -> 5% hosted canary (auto-roll back on regression) -> 25% canary with QA eval harness -> Dedicated opt-in -> default flip in 8 weeks if metrics pass.

ajay: Need enforcement contract for fallbacks: if strict mode rejects, we should fallback to compatible model or route to sandbox. Fallback must preserve caller semantics where possible.

mike: Telemetry events to emit: validation.failure, validation.autorepair, fallback.invoked, fallback.success, fallback.failure, fncall.latency. Include context: route_id, model_id, schema_id, customer_id (hashed).

sara: Docs tasks: small quickstart + error code mapping + migration guide for customers moving from permissive to strict. I'll own docs.

olivia: Owners / deadlines? I can own product acceptance criteria and rollout plan. Ajay to own runtime impl, Mike to own eval harness & metrics, Sara docs + SDKs, Dan security checklist. Target: lock PRD by Fri (1998765500).

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: fncall-validation v0.1 -> infra/devx cluster @ 1998765450. Use feature flag: fncall.validation.v0.1

olivia: Thanks — I'll update the PRD with these bullets and link PR for reviews. Please add comments in-thread if anything missing. :thumbsup:
